title: Weak Hessian bounds along every geodesic in RCD spaces
summary: On a full-support $`\mathrm{RCD}(K,N)`$ space with $`1\lt N\lt \infty`$, we prove that a bounded globally Lipschitz function whose distributional Hessian is bounded above by a bounded continuous function satisfies the corresponding second-derivative inequality along every minimizing geodesic.

review.reason: Establishes Hessian-type inequalities along geodesics in RCD spaces for Lipschitz functions.
